article.title: Syndigo擴展Copilot商品操作，AI修改資料須經人批准才保存
article.title_en: Syndigo expands Copilot product operations with human approval before saving changes
article.summary: Syndigo在11月18日擴展MCP功能，讓Copilot等AI助理從讀取商品資料進一步建立及修改記錄。
article.summary_en: Syndigo's November 18 MCP expansion lets Copilot and other assistants create and update product records beyond read-only access.
highlights: 可補全屬性、行銷文案及檢查零售商要求，修改前後值並排顯示。
人手批准後才保存；功能沿用客戶登入者的既有權限。
highlights_en: Assistants can enrich attributes and copy and check retailer requirements, showing proposed and current values side by side.
Changes save only after human approval and use the signed-in customer's existing permissions.
article.why: 商品準備流程增加可批准的AI寫入後，電商營運可決定哪些欄位適合批次補全，哪些文案仍須逐項審核。
article.why_en: Approval-based AI writes let commerce operations distinguish fields suitable for batch enrichment from copy requiring individual review.
article.next_step: 選一組待上架商品，指定可補全欄位及批准人，核對建議值、現值與零售商缺漏，再逐項批准保存。
article.next_step_en: Select products awaiting listing, define editable fields and approvers, then compare proposed values, existing data and retailer gaps before saving.
article.detail: MCP是連接AI助理與外部系統的協定；PIM及MDM分別管理商品資訊及主資料。公告把功能限定於Syndigo相關客戶及既有權限，並非任何Copilot用戶都能直接修改商品。編輯建議保留每次批准的欄位清單與理由，特別檢查尺寸、規格及描述是否一致；供應商聲稱的流程效率沒有在本篇被寫成已證明的銷售或速度提升。
article.detail_en: MCP connects assistants to external systems; PIM and MDM manage product information and master data. Access is for relevant Syndigo customers within existing permissions, not every Copilot user. Retain approved-field lists and inspect specifications and descriptions for consistency. The workflow is not independent proof of faster launches or increased sales.
